segments.t: Now while the multitude pressed
segments.note: 「Now while the multitude pressed on him」は ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ … ἐπικεῖσθαι の意訳

segments.t: on him and heard the word of God,
segments.note: 「and heard」は καὶ ἀκούειν

segments.t: he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret.
He saw two boats standing by the lake,
segments.note: 「He」は εἶδεν の主語（イエス）。冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: but the fishermen had gone out of them
and were washing their nets.
segments.note: 「their」は英語の補い

segments.t: He entered into one of the boats, which was Simon’s,
segments.note: δέ（2番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: and asked him to put out a little from the land.
He sat down and taught the multitudes from the boat.
segments.note: δέ（18番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: When he had finished speaking,
segments.note: 「When」は ὡς

segments.t: he said to Simon,
“Put out into the deep
and let down your nets for a catch.”
Simon answered him, “Master,
we worked all night and caught nothing;
but at your word I will let down the net.”
segments.note: EN は単数形「net」。原文は τὰ δίκτυα（複数）

segments.t: When they had done this,
segments.note: 「When」は τοῦτο ποιήσαντες の時間表現

segments.t: they caught a great multitude of fish,
and their net was breaking.
segments.note: EN は単数形「net」。原文は τὰ δίκτυα（複数）

segments.t: They beckoned to their partners in the other boat,
segments.note: 冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: that they should come and help them.
segments.note: 「that they should come and help them」は τοῦ ἐλθόντας συλλαβέσθαι αὐτοῖς

segments.t: They came and filled both boats, so that they began to sink.
segments.note: 「began to sink」は βυθίζεσθαι

segments.t: But Simon Peter, when he saw it,
segments.note: 「when he saw it」は ἰδὼν。δὲ（2番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying,
“Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, Lord.”
For he was amazed, and all
segments.note: 語順組み替え： θάμβος γὰρ περιέσχεν αὐτόν。「was amazed」は θάμβος περιέσχεν

segments.t: who were with him, at the catch of fish which they had caught;
and so also were James and John, sons of Zebedee,
segments.note: 「were」は前節 περιέσχεν の省略の補い

segments.t: who were partners with Simon.
Jesus said to Simon,
“Don’t be afraid.
From now on you will be catching people alive.”
segments.note: 語順組み替え： ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν ἀνθρώπους ἔσῃ ζωγρῶν

segments.t: When they had brought their boats to land,
segments.note: 「When」は καταγαγόντες の時間表現。「their」は英語の補い

segments.t: they left everything, and followed him.
While he was in one of the cities,
segments.note: 「While he was in one of the cities」は ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ εἶναι αὐτὸν ἐν μιᾷ τῶν πόλεων の意訳。冒頭の Καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: behold, there was a man full of leprosy.
segments.note: 「behold, there was」は καὶ ἰδοὺ

segments.t: When he saw Jesus, he fell on his face and begged him, saying,
segments.note: 「his face」は πρόσωπον（顔）＋文脈

segments.t: “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”
He stretched out his hand
segments.note: 「He stretched out his hand」は ἐκτείνας τὴν χεῖρα。冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: and touched him, saying,
segments.note: 語順組み替え： καὶ ἥψατο αὐτοῦ εἰπών

segments.t: “I want to. Be made clean.”
Immediately the leprosy left him.
He commanded him to tell no one,
“But go your way and show yourself to the priest,
segments.note: 「your way」は英語の補い

segments.t: and offer for your cleansing
according to what Moses commanded,
for a testimony to them.”
But the report concerning him spread much more,
and great multitudes came together to hear and to be healed
segments.note: 「came together」は συνήρχοντο

segments.t: by him of their infirmities.
segments.note: 「by him」は WEB が従う異読（ὑπ᾽ αὐτοῦ）の反映。ギリシャ語本文にはこの語はない

segments.t: But he withdrew himself into the desert and prayed.
segments.note: 句全体の対応： αὐτὸς δὲ ἦν ὑποχωρῶν ἐν ταῖς ἐρήμοις καὶ προσευχόμενος

segments.t: On one of those days, he was teaching;
and there were Pharisees and teachers of the law sitting by
who had come out of every village of Galilee, Judea, and Jerusalem.
The power of the Lord was with him to heal them.
segments.note: 「was with him to heal them」は εἰς τὸ ἰᾶσθαι αὐτόν（彼が癒すために）の意訳

segments.t: Behold, men brought a paralyzed man on a cot,
segments.note: 冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない。「a paralyzed man」は ἄνθρωπον ὃς ἦν παραλελυμένος

segments.t: and they sought to bring him in to lay before Jesus.
segments.note: 「Jesus」は αὐτοῦ の明示

segments.t: Not finding a way to bring him in because of the multitude,
segments.note: 「Not finding a way」は μὴ εὑρόντες ποίας

segments.t: they went up to the housetop and
let him down through the tiles with his cot
segments.note: 「his」は英語の補い

segments.t: into the middle before Jesus.
Seeing their faith,
segments.note: 冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: he said to him, “Man, your sins are forgiven you.”
segments.note: 「to him」は文脈の補い（麻痺の人へ）

segments.t: The scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying,
segments.note: 冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない。「began to reason」は ἤρξαντο διαλογίζεσθαι

segments.t: “Who is this who speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?”
But Jesus, perceiving their thoughts, answered them,
segments.note: 「But」は δὲ

segments.t: “Why are you reasoning so in your hearts?
segments.note: 「so」は英語の補い

segments.t: Which is easier to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven you,’ or to say, ‘Arise and walk’?
segments.note: 句全体の対応： τί ἐστιν εὐκοπώτερον εἰπεῖν Ἀφέωνταί σοι αἱ ἁμαρτίαι σου ἢ εἰπεῖν Ἔγειρε καὶ περιπάτει

segments.t: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins,”
segments.note: 「But」は δὲ。「may」は εἰδῆτε（知るために）

segments.t: he said to the paralyzed man,
“I tell you, arise, take up your cot, and go to your house.”
Immediately he rose up before them,
segments.note: 「Immediately」は παραχρῆμα。冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: and took up that which he was laying on,
segments.note: 「took up that which he was laying on」は ἄρας ἐφ᾽ ὃ κατέκειτο

segments.t: and departed to his house, glorifying God.
Amazement took hold on all,
segments.note: 「Amazement took hold on all」は ἔκστασις ἔλαβεν ἅπαντας。冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: and they glorified God. They were filled with fear,
segments.note: 「They were filled with fear」は ἐπλήσθησαν φόβου

segments.t: saying, “We have seen strange things today.”
segments.note: ὅτι は引用の導入

segments.t: After these things he went out and saw
segments.note: 冒頭の Καὶ は英語に現れない。「he」は ἐξῆλθεν の主語（イエス）

segments.t: a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax office,
segments.note: 「named Levi」は ὀνόματι Λευὶν

segments.t: and said to him, “Follow me!”
He left everything, and rose up and followed him.
segments.note: 句全体の対応： καὶ καταλιπὼν πάντα ἀναστὰς ἠκολούθει αὐτῷ

segments.t: Levi made a great feast for him in his house.
segments.note: 語順組み替え： ἐποίησεν δοχὴν μεγάλην Λευὶς αὐτῷ ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ αὐτοῦ。冒頭の Καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: There was a great crowd of tax collectors and others who were reclining with them.
segments.note: 「There」は形式主語

segments.t: Their scribes and the Pharisees murmured against his disciples,
segments.note: 語順組み替え： οἱ Φαρισαῖοι καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς αὐτῶν。冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: saying, “Why do you eat and drink with the tax collectors and sinners?”
segments.note: 「Why」は Διὰ τί

segments.t: Jesus answered them,
segments.note: 冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician,
but those who are sick do.
segments.note: 「do」は前半 ἔχουσιν の反復

segments.t: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance.”
segments.note: 句全体の対応： οὐκ ἐλήλυθα καλέσαι δικαίους ἀλλὰ ἁμαρτωλοὺς εἰς μετάνοιαν

segments.t: They said to him,
segments.note: 「They」は Οἱ

segments.t: “Why do
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「Why do」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの語はない

segments.t: John’s disciples often fast and pray,
likewise also the disciples of the Pharisees,
segments.note: 「disciples」は英語の補い（省略された μαθηταί）

segments.t: but yours eat and drink?”
He said to them,
segments.note: 「He」は ὁ（冠詞＋文脈）。δὲ（2番）は英語に現れない

segments.t: “Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast while the bridegroom is with them?
segments.note: 「friends」は υἱοὺς τοῦ νυμφῶνος（婚宴の子ら）の意訳。「while」は ἐν ᾧ

segments.t: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them.
segments.note: 「But」は δὲ。「will be taken away」は ἀπαρθῇ

segments.t: Then they will fast in those days.”
He also told a parable to them.
segments.note: 「also」は καὶ

segments.t: “No one puts a piece from a new garment on an old garment,
segments.note: 「puts」は ἐπιβάλλει。「piece from」は ἐπίβλημα ἀπό

segments.t: or else he will tear the new,
and also the piece from the new will not match the old.
segments.note: 語順組み替え： καὶ τῷ παλαιῷ οὐ συμφωνήσει τὸ ἐπίβλημα τὸ ἀπὸ τοῦ καινοῦ

segments.t: No one puts new wine into old wineskins,
or else the new wine will burst the skins,
and it will be spilled and the skins will be destroyed.
segments.note: 「it」は αὐτὸς（酒）

segments.t: But new wine must be put into fresh wineskins,
segments.note: 「must be put」は βλητέον

segments.t: and both are preserved.
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「and both are preserved」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの句はない

segments.t: No man having drunk old wine
segments.note: 冒頭の καὶ は英語に現れない

segments.t: immediately
segments.note: WEB はビザンティン本文に従い「immediately」を補う。ギリシャ語本文にこの語はない

segments.t: desires new,
for he says, ‘The old is better.’”
